title: Pipeline trigger endpoint with request validation
name: Pipeline trigger endpoint

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code validates the incoming trigger request? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client sends {"projectSlug":"web","ref":"main","variables":{"db_url":"x"}}. What does the endpoint do?
choices: Returns 202 Accepted because the variable name is only checked for length
Returns a validation problem for field variables.db_url because lowercase names are rejected
Returns 404 because ProjectSlug is too short to match any project
Throws a KeyNotFoundException because Variables was not bound from JSON

questions.prompt: Why does the endpoint compare request.Parallelism with project.MaxParallelism separately from the request validation step?
choices: Attribute validators cannot compare a number against a constant
It is a duplicate of the [Range] attribute and is never reached
DataAnnotations skip integer properties unless they are nullable
The limit depends on the project loaded from the catalog, which is not known when the request body is validated

questions.prompt: What does the endpoint store as the Ref of the queued run?
choices: The request value with leading and trailing whitespace removed
The default branch of the project, because Ref is optional
The request value upper-cased for consistent matching
